title: Letter Category · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Letter Category · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a letter and a broad category together. The lead names two different examples in the category that begin with that letter. Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Letter Category, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Both answers fit the category and start with the selected letter.
